items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for payment: 03.12.2026. No period to count, so this date stands as given. 2026-12-03 is a Thursday, not a weekend or public holiday in NW, so no shift is needed.

warnings: This is a reminder from a private club (Sportverein), not a German authority, so no statutory deemed-delivery or remedy rules apply; the 03.12.2026 date is simply the date printed in the letter.

The letter asks you to send a new SEPA mandate by email if your bank details changed — only do this through contact details you already have for the club, not by replying with new bank details to an unexpected request, as this is a common fraud pattern.
